about: Mentura's opinion of what must be finished before a workflow may start, for people and agents alike. A workflow's own requires field in Naive is added to these. Every rule that matches a workflow applies. <function> stands for the workflow's own function. A meeting is met only when it is closed with its outcome reached; a record only when it is live, never a held draft; a decision only when decided. Anything that cannot be checked counts as missing.

rules.why: Strategy comes first: no function is set up before the business knows its purpose, its customer and its problem.
A function is learned before it is run: its intake meeting closes before any of its other workflows starts.
Competitors are judged against the customer and the problem the business chose.
Nothing is said in public before the brand and the publication policy exist and a person has approved them.
No investor hears from the business before its goals and exit criteria are written and approved.
A site agent builds public pages: no one builds them before marketing is set up and the brand and the publication policy exist and a person has approved them.
